hasAction.description: Decision D5: the meaning of the type (prefLabel, definition, subClassOf) is kept apart from the rest. The six-phase position moves from skos:broader to pp:phase (classification); profile, processDescription and provenanceClass move to a node of their own (pp:deployment); the openEO correspondences are grouped apart. The plan was already a node of its own.

Attached to the Implementation Profile https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/radiometric-index-single-band (implementsProfile), after checking its signature (docs/ATTACHMENTS.md).

subClassOf changes from https://w3id.org/ogc/rim/activity-type/ActivityType to https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/activity-type/radiometric-index, the activity type of the operation in bblocks-generic-profiles (decision of 2026-11-10), with the same entity type(s): http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature, http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature.

definition: Computes the normalized difference index ((A-B)/(A+B)) of two co-registered rasters.

fixedRoleValues.reason: the tool computes (A-B)/(A+B) of rasters[0] and rasters[1] (app.py); which index it is depends on the bands passed (NDWI for green and NIR in W3)

assumedFormatGaps.name: rasters
assumedFormatGaps.reason: The CWL (GeoLabs/ogc-eo-application-package-hands-on f472585, `norm_diff.cwl`) declares no `format` on this File, so the processDescription derived by eoap.cct.cwl-to-ogcprocess serves application/octet-stream: the deployment exposes no media type for the GeoTIFF it reads or writes. Closed upstream if the CWL declares `format: ogc:geotiff`.
assumedFormatGaps.evidence: Run record `water-bodies` (scripts/sources.yaml): the `rasters` files of node_normalized_difference (crop_green.tif, crop_nir.tif) are single-band TIFFs with the GeoTIFF tags 33550, 33922, 34735, EPSG:32610 (observed 2026-11-10).

openeoEquivalence.rationale: Exact index formula, generic over which two bands are passed: NDWI (green, nir) in this workflow, same as `ogc.openeo.processes.math.indices.normalized_difference` used for NDVI elsewhere in this register (`kindgrove.mangrove`) -- it is the caller's band choice, not the tool, that names the index.
